text: CT Abdomen/Pelvis with IV contrast. FINDINGS: 4.2 cm heterogeneous mass in the head of pancreas with irregular margins. Mass encases the superior mesenteric artery (>180 degrees) and abuts the portal vein. Moderate intrahepatic biliary ductal dilatation and common bile duct dilatation (1.2 cm). Multiple hypodense liver lesions, largest 2.8 cm in segment 7, 1.9 cm in segment 4, and numerous sub-centimeter lesions throughout both lobes, consistent with metastatic disease. Moderate ascites present. Multiple peritoneal nodules. Peripancreatic and celiac axis lymphadenopathy. IMPRESSION: Locally advanced pancreatic head adenocarcinoma with liver metastases and peritoneal carcinomatosis. Unresectable disease (Stage IV). Recommend EUS-guided biopsy and genetic testing given family history. Biliary stent placement for obstructive jaundice.
